note: Contract 1.3 glob / not-glob (#80, #232). Generated from the TS renderer (the reference) and checked against SQLite. engine.ts and the Rust engine must render findSql byte for byte, match the same rows, and refuse the same conditions. Not part of the corpus: adding cases here does not change corpus_version.

cases.name: absolute path
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '/*')

cases.name: absolute path: relative entry
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '/*')

cases.name: parent segment at start
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '../*')

cases.name: parent segment in the middle
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*/../*')

cases.name: parent segment: dots inside a name are not a segment
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*/../*')

cases.name: parent segment at end
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*/..')

cases.name: current segment
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*/./*')

cases.name: backslash anywhere (GLOB has no escape char)
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*\*')

cases.name: backslash: none present
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*\*')

cases.name: control character
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*[-]*')

cases.name: control character: tab
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*[-]*')

cases.name: control character: clean name
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*[-]*')

cases.name: empty segment
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*//*')

cases.name: single package prefix: inside
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB 'package/*')

cases.name: single package prefix: outside, found by not-glob
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path NOT GLOB 'package/*')

cases.name: single package prefix: inside, not-glob does not match
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path NOT GLOB 'package/*')

cases.name: case-sensitive (unlike LIKE)
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB 'Package/*')

cases.name: ? matches exactly one character
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB 'v?.txt')

cases.name: ? does not match two
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB 'v?.txt')

cases.name: character class
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*.[jt]s')

cases.name: negated character class
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*.[^jt]s')

cases.name: quote in the pattern is escaped, not SQL
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB 'it''s*')

cases.name: unicode literal
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '包/*')

cases.name: NULL never matches glob
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path GLOB '*')

cases.name: NULL never matches not-glob either
cases.findSql: SELECT path FROM entries WHERE (path NOT GLOB 'x*')

rejects.name: op outside the closed set is never spliced into SQL
